title: "Problems"

---

BENQODHI is building a set of candidate benchmark problems at the intersection of
optimisation, life sciences and health. This page tracks the working-table themes for
the Day 2 working session and the candidate problems proposed so far.

Candidates are welcome from anyone — see [Contribute](../contribute.qmd) for how to
propose one. The Day 2 [seed problem brief](../roundtables/seed-problem-brief.qmd)
collects starting points for the working-table discussion.

## Common template

Every candidate problem is described using the same structure, so proposals, working
notes and finished problem pages all stay comparable:

1. **Use case** — the biological or clinical task, and why it matters
2. **Formal problem** — objective, decision variables, constraints
3. **Instances** — real, synthetic or generated; provenance, scale, format
4. **Source of difficulty** — why it is hard
5. **Baselines** — current methods and available implementations
6. **Metrics** — success measures, resource accounting
7. **Ready vs. missing** — honest gap analysis
8. **Next action** — one named person, one concrete step

## Day 2 working-table themes

These are the four working-table themes proposed for the Day 2 morning session
(see [Program](../program.qmd)). They are a starting point for grouping candidate
problems, not a final classification.

| Table | Theme |
|---|---|
| 1 | Large-scale bioinformatics and genomics optimisation, and NP-hard problems |
| 2 | AI / QML |
| 3 | Radiotherapy and other hard health problems, medical imaging |
| 4 | Benchmark framework: instances, baselines, repository and reporting |

## Datasets

No benchmark datasets have been published yet. Once instances exist for a problem,
they will be linked from that problem's page, along with generator code where
applicable.
